title: GitDealFlow Answers
description: Q&A answer pages from GitDealFlow, Track startup acquisitions & funding rounds

items.title: How do I track startup acquisitions in real time?
items.content_text: GitDealFlow monitors SEC filings, press releases, and funding databases to surface startup acquisitions as they happen, with deal size estimates, acquirer profiles, and market sector analysis.

items.title: What's the difference between GitDealFlow and Crunchbase?
items.content_text: GitDealFlow focuses exclusively on M&A deal flow with real-time alerts, proprietary valuation estimates, and investor signal scoring, Crunchbase is a broader company database with delayed M&A data.

items.title: How do investors use acquisition data to find opportunities?
items.content_text: Investors use GitDealFlow to identify acquisition patterns, which companies are buying in which sectors, at what multiples, to spot undervalued startups and predict the next acquisition targets.
